integrity: The finite tables are exactly enumerable with the accompanying standalone checker; the infinite family has an algebraic proof independent of computations.
scientific_limitations: The complete fiber census concerns only prime orders 5, 7, and 11. For all larger primes the result supplies an explicit inequivalent homometric pair, not a complete fiber classification. Bibliographic equivalence with older signed-sequence catalogs is a residual risk.
title: Prime-order onset and first ambiguous fibers for signed four-atom Fourier phase retrieval
